findings.claim: Prior cumulative deny artifacts remain append-only and indicate that 615 URLs were observed in terminal lineage and must remain exposure unless separately re-authorized under a distinct method with a new frozen exposure lineage rule.
findings.uncertainty: Predecessor provenance and exposure traversal are only as complete as the documented chain and may not represent external source ecosystems outside this repository scope.
findings.remediation: Require full exposure-chain traversal for any future distinct method before candidate approval.

findings.claim: No method route option is acceptable while still allowing reuse of any of the deniable or observed URLs, including the 96-row planning set and residual 82 observations from terminal stop evidence.
findings.uncertainty: Exposure list is a strict project-control artifact and does not imply legal rights resolution.
findings.remediation: Bind any future manifest row to a post-exposure cumulative-chain check and reject any reused URL deterministically.

options.description: Perform repository-only manifest drafting, frame governance, and exposure checks, then pause for owner authorization.
trade_offs: Delays any execution evidence for another short cycle.
limitations: No freshness checks against runtime changes in external sources.
options.contingency: If manifest or traversal cannot be made deterministic, keep work in repository-only design form and return for revised plan.

options.description: Adopt official-manifest-only extraction of candidate rows and defer directory traversal until manifest success criteria are proven.
trade_offs: Strong reduction in accidental rediscovery risk
limitations: Could produce sparse frames for some jurisdictions.
options.contingency: If sparsity blocks threshold, request a revised owner decision with expanded contingency handling before execution.

recommendation: Recommend Option A (prepare-only with cumulative-exposure gates) and defer any manifest crawl or directory traversal until a separate exact owner authorization is issued.
rationale: The terminal overlap failure indicates that execution risk is currently dominated by exposure-compliance risk, so repository-only preparation is the only posture consistent with no-further-overlap policy.
conflicts: This review does not assert any legal, rights, privacy, or independent quality assurance for future candidates.
abstentions: No candidate traversal was executed in this review.
